item.title: Disturbance of land permit not yet approved for Pumpkin Center data center
item.description: Columbia County has not yet approved the reapplication for a disturbance of land permit for the developers to launch Phase 1 of the construction of Project Pumpkin, the data center facility at the 420 acre Pumpkin Center property in Harlem. The post Disturbance of land permit not yet approved for Pumpkin Center data center appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County commissioners approve adoption of Foundations for the Future plan
item.description: The Columbia County Board of Commissioners approved a resolution to adopt the Foundations for the Future comprehensive plan on Tuesday. The post Columbia County commissioners approve adoption of Foundations for the Future plan appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: One lawn department to mow all: Augusta votes to consolidate groundskeeping
item.description: The Augusta Commission moved forward Tuesday on a plan to consolidate city mowing, vegetation and grounds work into a single department. The post One lawn department to mow all: Augusta votes to consolidate groundskeeping appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: One person injured in officer involved shooting in Richmond County
item.description: One person was injured in a shooting with a Richmond County Sheriff's Office deputy late Tuesday night. The post One person injured in officer involved shooting in Richmond County appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Driver dies after single-vehicle crash in Columbia County, coroner says
item.description: A man died Tuesday after a single-vehicle crash in Columbia County, according to the Columbia County Coroner’s Office. The post Driver dies after single-vehicle crash in Columbia County, coroner says appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Josey student faces felony charge for assault on school officer
item.description: A student at T.W. Josey High School was arrested Tuesday for allegedly punching a school officer and injuring him. The post Josey student faces felony charge for assault on school officer appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Chief civil and magistrate judge running for second term
item.description: Incumbent Chief Civil and Magistrate Judge Carletta Sims Brown is running for a second term presiding over the Richmond County court. The post Chief civil and magistrate judge running for second term appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Suspect ‘stable,’ deputy on leave after officer-involved shooting
item.description: A sheriff’s deputy is on administrative leave and a Hephzibah man is in stable condition after an officer-involved shooting Tuesday. The post Suspect ‘stable,’ deputy on leave after officer-involved shooting appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: One person was killed in a shooting on Winesap Way Wednesday night. The post One person killed in Wednesday night shooting appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Trader Joe’s in Columbia County has been in the works for two years. Where will it go?
item.description: Trader Joe’s prospective arrival to Columbia County has been widely publicized since the California grocery store chain confirmed Monday that it’s in talks to open a new store in Evans.
